about.description: A jq-like Markdown query language for command-line processing
about.head: 92f18d7

name: v0.10.0
body:
## 🎯 Highlights

- Rewritten Markdown parser: now built in instead of relying on markdown-rs. Faster and more conformant (CommonMark/GFM), with support for Obsidian syntax and MDX frontmatter.
- Smarter type checker: fewer false positives and clearer errors. Uncertain errors are hidden unless you ask for them.
- Closer to jq: jq exit codes, JSON Lines input and output, and @html/@uri/sh now match jq.
- Easier CLI: pass a directory or glob and mq finds the Markdown files. --color auto-detects, and there's a Windows install.ps1.

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes

### Query language

- **`??` and `@` precedence changed.** `??` now binds looser than arithmetic and comparison operators (between `||` and `&&`), and `@` binds tighter than `*` `/` `%`. `a ?? b + c` is now `a ?? (b + c)`. Add parentheses where you mixed them.
- **`@ :html` now escapes HTML.** It HTML-escapes the value, like jq's `@html`, and no longer renders Markdown. Use `to_html` for that. `@ :uri` and `url_encode` no longer escape `-_.~`.
- **Removed `http_*` wrapper builtins.** `http_get`, `http_post`, `http_put`, `http_patch`, `http_delete`, `http_head` and the `http_*_json` variants are gone. Use `http(:get, url, headers)` instead.

### CLI

- **Exit codes for errors changed.** Uncaught errors now exit with `2` (unreadable file), `3` (syntax or module error) or `5` (runtime error) without `-e`. They used to exit with `1`.
- **`-c` is now `--compact`**, as in jq. `--count` is long-only.
- **`--args NAME VALUE` is now `--arg NAME VALUE`**, and `--argv` is now `--args`.
- **`--list` is now `mq commands`.**

### Markdown

- Markdown is now parsed by mq's own parser instead of `markdown-rs`.

## What's Changed

### Features

* ✨ feat(check): type-check the module definitions that user code reaches by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2572
* ✨ feat(check): split type errors into definite and possible, and cut false positives by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2602
* ✨ feat(check): type array first/last/get as element | none by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2704
* ✨ feat(check): make the type checker more reliable and its diagnostics clearer by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2715
* ✨ feat(ffi): add structured errors, typed values and opaque options by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2671
* ✨ feat(install): add install.ps1 for Windows by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2712
* ✨ feat(lang): add multi-key sort_rows and transform_tables to table module by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2622
* ✨ feat(lang): accept column names in table module functions by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2624
* ✨ feat(lang): add mkdir builtin by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2688
* ✨ feat(markdown): add native Markdown parser by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2489
* ✨ feat(run): follow jq exit codes under --exit-status by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2614
* ✨ feat(run): support JSON Lines input and output by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2638
* ✨ feat(run): read Markdown files under a directory argument by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2648
* ✨ feat(run): auto-detect color output with --color by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2697

### Fixes

* 🐛 fix(bench): report failing benchmarks in output and on stderr by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2679
* 🐛 fix(check): resolve feature-gated builtins in builtin.mq and html.mq by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2659
* 🐛 fix(check): report type errors for mkdir and in with a dict by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2690
* 🐛 fix(check): type argument selectors on unknown input and self[...]  by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2705
* 🐛 fix(crawler): honour robots.txt per origin and bound responses by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2674
* 🐛 fix(docs): add missing keywords to syntax highlighters by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2709
* 🐛 fix(ffi): harden the C API for untrusted queries by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2670
* 🐛 fix(formatter): do not indent a literal with bracket access after def by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2609
* 🐛 fix(formatter): do not add spaces around a tokenless block in call args by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2653
* 🐛 fix(formatter): stop duplicating comments above space-chained selectors by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2676
* 🐛 fix(lang): order mixed-type arrays in sort and sort_by by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2561
* 🐛 fix(lang): lex `+`/`-` after a value as binary operators by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2571
* 🐛 fix(lang): parse index access on dict literals by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2596
* 🐛 fix(lang): parse index access on string literals by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2597
* 🐛 fix(lang): report circular module dependencies as an error by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2599
* 🐛 fix(lang): keep postfix index and call across newlines in CST  by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2600
* 🐛 fix(lang): return None for out-of-range negative index by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2603
* 🐛 fix(lang): return None for non-integer index by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2604
* 🐛 fix(lang): report unindexable values as an indexing error by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2606
* 🐛 fix(lang): return none for non-integer slice bounds by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2608
* 🐛 fix(lang): put number before string in number + string concatenation by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2631
* 🐛 fix(lang): include function name and value in conversion errors by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2632
* 🐛 fix(lang): align CST and AST on selector chains and while conditions  by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2634
* 🐛 fix(lang): reject non-integer sizes in chunks by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2662
* 🐛 fix(lang): make NaN comparisons follow IEEE 754 by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2663
* 🐛 fix(lang): reject non-finite or non-integer args in gcd and lcm by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2664
* 🐛 fix(lang): report callee name in arity errors for mq-defined functions by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2665
* 🐛 fix(lang): return character offsets from index, rindex and indices  by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2667
* 🐛 fix(lang): keep Unicode letters in slugify by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2668
* 🐛 fix(lang): treat an empty dict as falsy in conditions by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2685
* 🐛 fix(lang): make array * number repeat-only by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2686
* 🐛 fix(lang): hint at mq literals when null, True or False is used by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2698
* 🐛 fix(lang): keep earlier closures' captured value when `let` is rebound by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2703
* 🐛 fix(lang): skip leading BOM in query and module sources by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2707
* 🐛 fix(lang): hint dict key access for selectors written after an iden by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2708
* 🐛 fix(lang): reject duplicate def and conflicting members across module declarations by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2711
* 💥 fix(lang)!: align `@ :html`, `@ :uri` and `@ :sh` with jq by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2716
* 🐛 fix(lang): reject stack-growing bytecode loops and add Kani proofs by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2724
* 🐛 fix(lang): require `end` in match expressions by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2728
* 💥 fix(lang)!: lower ?? below && and raise @ above multiplicative  by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2731
* 🐛 fix(lint): do not report unused functions in module files by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2657
* 🐛 fix(lsp): validate new name in textDocument/rename by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2677
* 🐛 fix(markdown): do not loosen a list when a fence follows a quote in an item by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2594
* 🐛 fix(markdown): convert `<b>` and `<i>` to bold and italic in html_to_markdown by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2666
* 🐛 fix(markdown): replace U+0000 with U+FFFD when parsing by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2723
* 🐛 fix(repl): hide module symbols from /vars by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2680
* 🐛 fix(run): pass options through to external subcommands without `--` by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2615
* 🐛 fix(run): write every input to -o instead of keeping only the last by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2621
* 🐛 fix(run): run `.` instead of starting the REPL when stdin is piped without a query by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2642
* 🐛 fix(run): hide internal query prelude from diagnostics by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2645
* 🐛 fix(run)!: return jq exit codes 2/3/5 for errors without --exit-status by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2651
* 🐛 fix(run): write -o output through a symlink instead of replacing it by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2652
* 🐛 fix(run): reject --args that leaves no query by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2673
* 🐛 fix(run): report one-based source positions in the debugger by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2675
* 🐛 fix(run): make --exit-status depend only on whether a result is empty by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2682
* 🐛 fix(run): ignore write failures when reporting errors to stderr by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2684
* 🐛 fix(run): compile the query before reading stdin by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2689
* 🐛 fix(run): ignore access events in --watch  by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2691
* 🐛 fix(run): write well-formed XML for invalid names and attributes by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2692
* 🐛 fix(run): omit None keys in TOML output and name the path of None in arrays by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2693
* 🐛 fix(run): quote 0o octal, underscored integer and date strings in YAML output by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2694
* 🐛 fix(run): reject empty, whitespace-only and comment-only queries consistently by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2699
* 🐛 fix(run): report input line numbers for invalid JSONL records by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2730
* 🔒 fix(run)!: prefix `-F shell` variable names to prevent env overwrite by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2733
* 🐛 fix(test): support `import "test"` in mq-test files by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2687
* reject trailing pipe without a right-hand expression by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2598

### Documentation

* 📝 docs(lang): document terminators for nested functions by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2706
* 📝 docs(run): clarify --aggregate and --eval-all help by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2633
* 📝 docs(skills): use -I raw instead of the non-existent --csv flag by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2696
* 📝 docs: deny missing_docs and document all public items by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2573
* 📝 docs: add Scoop installation instructions by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2595
* 📝 docs: fix incorrect examples and make them executable  by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2643
* 📝 docs: add a README to each crate that shared the top-level one by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2678
* 📝 docs: add evaluation model page and clarify exit status on Markdown  input by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2681

### Refactoring

* ♻  refactor(editors): replace Start LSP Server with Restart by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2639
* ♻  refactor(lang): mark error enums as non_exhaustive by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2562
* ♻  refactor(lang): remove section::has_content, deprecate *_header_depth by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2607
* 🔥 refactor(lang): remove deprecated increase_header_depth and decrease_header_depth by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2626
* 🔥 refactor(lang)!: remove http_* wrapper builtins by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2656
* ♻  refactor(lang): remove unwrap from parser by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2729
* ♻  refactor(run): align CLI flags with jq and move actions to subcommnds by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2575
* ♻  refactor(scripts): bump versions through the toml and json modules by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2563
* ♻  refactor: shrink the release binary and remove dead code by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2580
* ♻  refactor: move mq-web-api to its own repository by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2623
* 🧹 chore: remove deprecated builtins and dead code, split large test modules by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2627

### Performance

* ⚡ perf(check): shrink binaries and tidy mq-check internals by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2564
* ⚡ perf(lang): compile x = set(x, k, v) to an in-place index assignment  by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2579
* ⚡ perf(markdown): parse deeply nested lists in time linear in the input by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2658
* ⚡ perf(markdown): reduce memory used by large Markdown inputs by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2710
* ⚡ perf(wasm): build wasm packages with opt-level=z by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2582
* ⚡ perf: compile syntax highlight regexes once by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2581

### Test

* 👷 ci: run tests on all OSes for every push and PR by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2588
* ✨ ci: report spec conformance in the weekly job summary by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2593

### Other

* 🔧 chore(bench): remove benchmarks not run by CI or any just recipe by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2574
* 💄 style(playground): use Space Grotesk for header title by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2655
* 🔧 chore(task): sync task.md with justfile and use mq-task parallel/if/cache by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2569
* 🔧 build: align Dockerfile and rust-toolchain to Rust 1.99.1 by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2644
* 👷 ci: manage action versions with gh actions-lock by @harehare in https://github.com/harehare/mq/pull/2732
